scope: current scan active box OVERDOSE edge-residue control; no key derivation, hashing, WIF, seed, address, BIP39, or broad brute force

method.boundedVariantSet: same eight O4/B4/G5/O5 witness-box substitutions from the current scan target witness gate
method.candidateRequirement: exact active boxes plus all-four edge/center closeness plus source-backed R3

decision.reason: Exact active centers repeat the known OVED stream, but 0/4 exact active centers are close to slot centers at <=16px and the exact left/right edge streams are mixed. A substituted annotated O4 variant has better all-four any-anchor closeness than the exact active boxes, so edge residue is not exact-active-specific and has no source-backed R3 permission.

nextMove: Do not pursue active-box edge/center residue as an extraction selector. The next useful local pass should inspect a different source/provenance surface, or stop until a true physical/original-layout asset or raw clue wording supplies unit/order/transform.
